matching.normalize_subject: Before matching: fold the dash family (em dash, en dash, figure dash, minus) to '-', drop every non-ASCII character (emoji), collapse runs of whitespace to one space, compare case-insensitively. Same normalization as _shared/outlook-sent-probe.ps1 Normalized mode.
matching.pattern_syntax: fallback_email_subject_pattern is a regular expression applied with search (not anchored unless it starts with ^) to the NORMALIZED subject. It is written as ASCII lookaheads so the tokens match in any order — live subjects for the same producer vary in token order (e.g. 'PUBLICATION FAILED ora-automation-health-monitor 2026-09-10' vs '❌ ora-automation-health-monitor PUBLICATION FAILED — 2026-09-11').

placeholders.{DATE}: the expected output date as YYYY-MM-DD

matching.undated_subjects: If a pattern contains no date placeholder, the email counts only if its send time (Sent Items SentOn, or the send-log line's timestamp, ET) falls on the expected date or within the following 24h.
evidence_sources: C:\Users\Owner\.claude\scheduled-tasks\_shared\send-log.txt — '[OK] Sent' lines only; a '[FAIL]' line is not delivery
matching.null_pattern: fallback_email_subject_pattern null = the producer has no email path while Notion create is blocked; a missing page escalates exactly as before.
